reportTemplate.summary: Added the dashboard tag "bench" via Edit → Settings → tags (the setting pane then showed a "Remove \"bench\" tag" control, confirming the tag was stored), then saved with "Save dashboard", where I explicitly ticked the "Update default time range" checkbox (verified checked in the save dialog's Changes tab) and entered a message. After a full page reload of /d/{{v3}}/{{v4}}, the time range picker reads "Last 6 hours" and the URL carries from=now-6h&to=now, proving the range persisted; the dashboard also still renders the "{{v2}} Notes" text panel ("Run ID: {{v2}}") and the "{{v2}} Availability" Stat panel. Caveat: I could not read the tag pill in the dashboard header view — my final selector-based checks for a rendered "bench" tag returned no elements (my selectors were guesses), so the tag is confirmed as set in Dashboard settings, not re-observed as a header pill on the reloaded view. (availability_panel: Stat, 36.0)
